entries.name: Umbral Mirror
entries.summary: You wrap yourself in reactive shadow that throws false silhouettes and delayed motions around attacks. It protects several angles through misdirection rather than becoming solid armor.

entries.name: Umbral Snare
entries.summary: Twist nearby shadow into a clinging distraction around feet, hands, or vision. Briefly hinders a target without fully restraining them.

entries.name: Unassailable Poise
entries.summary: You use impeccable etiquette to survive formal pressure, insult, rank-testing, and social traps without surrendering your position or committing an unintended breach. The technique protects your standing; it does not grant rank you lack.

entries.name: Unbowed Presence
entries.summary: You stand with such absolute authority that fear, pain, humiliation, and hostile pressure fail to make you bend. Use this to dominate a room, resist intimidation, hold command under impossible pressure, or make enemies hesitate before treating you as defeated.

entries.name: Unbreakable Covenant
entries.summary: You establish an exceptionally powerful mutual oath with explicit terms, witnesses, and consequences accepted by all bound parties. The magic enforces the agreed structure, not hidden meanings or involuntary loyalty.

entries.name: Unbreakable Fiction
entries.summary: You maintain a complex false identity or purpose across several audiences, records, relationships, and contradictory pressures, keeping each version mutually compatible. The technique can withstand extraordinary scrutiny but not incontrovertible evidence or magical truth that directly exposes the lie.

entries.name: Unbroken Aegis
entries.summary: You raise a legendary defense that becomes the point the scene breaks against. Use this to shield allies from devastating force, deny a lethal supernatural effect, protect a retreat, or hold the final line during a crisis. This should feel like duty under immense pressure, not effortless invulnerability.

entries.name: Unbroken Banner
entries.summary: Project a rallying protective presence around nearby allies, helping them resist fear, despair, intimidation, and the collapse of a defensive line while they continue to act. It strengthens resolve and mutual protection without forcing courage or erasing real danger.

entries.name: Unbroken Command
entries.summary: You restore order after fear, casualties, conflicting instructions, or sudden disruption by giving a clear priority and making subordinate actions fit it. Use this to turn a wavering group back into coordinated motion during a major crisis.

entries.name: Unbroken Creed
entries.summary: You keep conviction intact under supernatural corruption, apparent miracles, despair, or revelations designed to break belief. Use this to endure a major spiritual trial and choose action from faith rather than panic.

entries.name: Unbroken Provenance
entries.summary: You reconstruct a defensible chain of provenance from damaged, contradictory, altered, or scattered records, showing what was created when, by whom, under which authority, and where the chain breaks. Use this to make a complex documentary case auditable without inventing missing evidence.

entries.name: Unbroken Rider
entries.summary: You make a mount perform like a heroic partner rather than transport, trusting impossible timing, terrain, and danger. Can cross a battlefield, rescue an ally, or escape pursuit through conditions that should unseat any rider.

entries.name: Unbroken Wall
entries.summary: Become the center of a defensive stand where allies can rally and enemies must break you before they can pass. Turns one position into a major obstacle against ordinary assault.

entries.name: Uncrossed Reach
entries.summary: You turn reach into battlefield law, making every path through your area pass under your weapon first. Can deny movement to a formation, rider, or large creature for a decisive moment.

entries.name: Under-Fire Stabilization
entries.summary: Keep working on a badly wounded person through noise, pain, exhaustion, and immediate danger long enough to prevent rapid deterioration. It buys time for extraction or deeper treatment rather than restoring full health.

entries.name: Undertow Passage
entries.summary: You use underwater terrain, breath control, and current to travel unseen or reach a submerged objective. Can bypass surface guards or hazards where water provides a real route.

entries.name: Underworld Sign
entries.summary: You recognize common criminal warnings, territory marks, fence signals, protection signs, or coded street etiquette without assuming every symbol is universal.

entries.name: Unmoving World
entries.summary: Root your body and carried burden into a titan-like stance, becoming extraordinarily difficult to push, topple, drag, crush, or force aside while you continue holding, bracing, lifting, or protecting. The environment beneath you can still fail.

entries.name: Unravel Ward
entries.summary: You drive Ruin Arcana into one existing magical defense and accelerate its weakest failure point. It can tear open a temporary breach without automatically destroying the entire enchantment.

entries.name: Unseen Crossing
entries.summary: Cross a hostile area by exploiting every blind spot, noise mask, and patrol habit in sequence. Bypasses ordinary guards and alarms if no impossible barrier prevents passage.

entries.name: Unshaken Nerve
entries.summary: You recover your judgment after horror, panic, humiliation, or a morale-breaking shock before it can dictate the scene. Use this to regain purposeful action and keep fear from deciding for you.

entries.name: Vampiric Regeneration
entries.summary: Stored blood vitality accelerates your undead recovery when you have fed recently or still possess enough blood. Use this to recover from injury, stabilize yourself, or return to fighting condition, but sunlight, holy power, starvation, fire, and severe damage can slow or prevent the recovery.

entries.name: Vanishing Angle
entries.summary: Break line of sight during movement and reappear from a better angle before enemies adjust. Enables repositioning into concealment during active danger.

entries.name: Vanishing Identity
entries.summary: You migrate between identities during an active search by shedding tells, changing silhouette, and using crowd expectation. Breaks pursuit that relies on appearance, clothing, or social category.

entries.name: Vanity Reading
entries.summary: Detect vanity, insecurity, concealed desire, or social fear by watching responses to praise, reflection, clothing, beauty, rank, or status display. Reveals insecurity, concealed desire, or social fear through status behavior.

entries.name: Vault Sense
entries.summary: You treat enclosed danger like a puzzle of floors, doors, echoes, dust, and missing pieces. Use this to move through ruins, dungeons, sealed rooms, or suspicious underground spaces more safely.

entries.name: Vaulting Staff
entries.summary: You vault, pivot, or brace with the staff as a moving support, turning bad footing into reach and momentum. Lets you cross a gap, recover balance, or strike from an unexpected line.

entries.name: Vector Reversal
entries.summary: Catch one incoming physical or magical impact that expresses clear directional force and turn much of its vector aside or back along a plausible line. It is exceptionally strong against a single committed threat but does not reflect every attack around you.

entries.name: Veil Crossing Rite
entries.summary: Perform a dangerous rite at a threshold between living and dead concerns. Allows contact, passage, or release that ordinary prayer cannot achieve.

entries.name: Veiled Face
entries.summary: You alter one face, voice, silhouette, or clothing impression with a compact illusion. It survives casual attention but can fail under touch, close scrutiny, or magical examination.

entries.name: Vein Line
entries.summary: Exploit a precise opening in an opponent's guard by targeting balance, grip, weapon control, or an exposed seam in their defense. On a clean hit, it creates a brief disabling setback rather than relying on greater bodily injury.

entries.name: Velvet Armor
entries.summary: You turn protocol into active defense, forcing rivals to choose between respecting formal limits or visibly violating them. Use this to expose improper pressure, slow an ambush of procedure, or make an aggressor pay a reputational cost for breaking the room’s rules.

entries.name: Velvet Deflection
entries.summary: You use charm, restraint, and emotional timing to defuse tension inside an active romantic or courtship interaction. Use this to recover from a misunderstanding, soften an awkward romantic moment, or redirect suspicion about your intentions when the other person has room to be persuaded.

entries.name: Venom Brand
entries.summary: You bind a tailored magical toxin to one weapon, bite, needle, or exposed target. Choose a coherent effect such as weakness, numbness, pain, or slowed movement rather than an instant kill.

entries.name: Venom Rewrite
entries.summary: Analyze and magically alter the active behavior of one toxin or venom you can access, weakening it, changing its onset, or converting part of it toward an antidotal reaction. Unknown mixtures, overwhelming doses, and magical poisons can resist or behave unpredictably.

entries.name: Venom Thread
entries.summary: You draw poison into, out of, or through a small target with careful control. Use this to slow venom in a victim, weaken a toxin, poison a blade, contaminate a small object, or turn an existing poison against its source.

entries.name: Vertical Bypass
entries.summary: You read a vertical surface as terrain, finding holds, rests, hidden ledges, and safe angles others miss. Can bypass gates, walls, cliffs, or collapsed routes through vertical movement.

entries.name: Vibration Palm
entries.summary: You read vibration through a connected surface to notice nearby footsteps, moving machinery, running water, impacts, or hollow space.

entries.name: Vital Exchange
entries.summary: You move a measured amount of vitality between willing or magically linked bodies, converting one person strain into another recovery. The donor suffers the transferred cost and cannot give more than they can survive.

entries.name: Vitriol Deluge
entries.summary: You unleash a wide caustic downpour that eats exposed material across a battlefield zone. Its breadth lowers raw precision, but it can deny ground, ruin cover, and force protected enemies to move.

entries.name: Voice of Order
entries.summary: Your command hits the scene like an unavoidable order. Use this to direct soldiers, guards, workers, allies, or civilians during crisis, forcing scattered action into disciplined movement.

entries.name: Voice of the Veil
entries.summary: Let a powerful dead memory or sacred presence speak through the moment without surrendering yourself completely. Reveals a major spiritual truth or demand if the rite is properly grounded.

entries.name: Wagon Shield
entries.summary: You make the vehicle itself a shield, barrier, or moving platform in danger. Can cover allies, block a path, or carry a wounded person through hostile terrain.

entries.name: Wake the Provenance
entries.summary: Use construction, markings, wear, and historical context to identify the most likely tradition, owner, or intended role of an unfamiliar relic. It can expose the right line of inquiry without safely activating the object.

entries.name: Walking Grove
entries.summary: You animate a large mass of roots, trees, or living timber into a moving defensive landscape. It can shelter allies, block lanes, and seize ground, but needs substantial plant life to work with.

entries.name: Wallstep
entries.summary: You use a wall, rail, table, tree, or other solid contact as a momentary step instead of stopping at the obstacle. Use this to redirect a jump, clear a cramped gap, or change height and angle during movement; the surface must actually bear the contact.

entries.name: War-Stopping Accord
entries.summary: You build a multi-party settlement that can function even when the participants do not trust one another, using guarantees, face-saving terms, reciprocal costs, and enforceable sequencing. Use this to create a credible path away from war or mass violence; acceptance still belongs to the parties involved.

entries.name: Ward
entries.summary: You place a protective boundary around a person, doorway, object, camp, or small area. Use this to resist intrusion, curses, hostile magic, fear, undead pressure, or environmental danger for a limited time.

entries.name: Wardship Leverage
entries.summary: Use mentorship, guardianship, fosterage, apprenticeship, sponsorship, or dependent obligations to secure cooperation without open coercion. Turns guardianship, sponsorship, mentorship, or dependent obligation into cooperation pressure.

entries.name: Warforge Restoration
entries.summary: You rebuild severely damaged weapons, armor, tools, or fittings for a major trial, correcting hidden stress and reinforcing the parts most likely to fail. The work can restore exceptional gear to fighting condition but still requires material, heat, tools, and time.

entries.name: Warning Read
entries.summary: You read instrument, wind, current, vibration, and engine strain as one warning system. Reveals the safest immediate maneuver before the craft loses stability.

entries.name: Water Jet
entries.summary: You project a focused stream of water with enough force to stagger, displace, extinguish, clean, or move objects at short range. Use this to attack, control footing, or manipulate liquid under pressure.

entries.name: Waterbreath
entries.summary: You maintain a thin exchange of breathable air through water around yourself or one willing target. It supports underwater action for a limited scene but does not protect against pressure, cold, or currents.

entries.name: Wayfinder's Pulse
entries.summary: You connect terrain, weather, landmarks, memory, and instinct into a clear route forward. Use this to guide a group through confusing wilderness, ruins, bad weather, or unfamiliar roads without losing momentum.

entries.name: Weak-Link Pressure
entries.summary: You focus threat on the person most likely to break the group's resolve. Can make a weaker enemy hesitate, speak, back down, or look to their leader for reassurance.

entries.name: Weakpoint Sight
entries.summary: You study a visible structure, armor, mechanism, formation, or creature and identify one plausible exposed seam or stress point for later action.

entries.name: Weaponize Courtesy
entries.summary: Use rank, precedent, forms of address, and ceremonial rules to block an improper demand or force it to be stated in a more accountable formal way. It works where the symbols and procedure actually matter.

entries.name: Weaponstorm
entries.summary: You seize several loose metal weapons, shards, or tools and drive them through a controlled orbit. They can defend space, threaten multiple targets, or strip unattended metal from a battlefield.

entries.name: Weather Signs
entries.summary: You read clouds, pressure, animal behavior, wind, moisture, and terrain to judge the likely short-term weather trend and what conditions may worsen.

entries.name: Weatherwise Suspicion
entries.summary: Tell when a ship, crew, cargo delay, route excuse, or travel claim does not match the weather, tide, river, or road conditions. Exposes route, cargo, or travel claims that do not match weather and tide.

entries.name: Weight and Leverage
entries.summary: Use tools, ropes, carts, stone, furniture, terrain, or load-bearing objects to restrain, delay, redirect, or control enemies. Turns objects, tools, and terrain into control over movement or enemies.

entries.name: Weight of Script
entries.summary: You write with such authority of form that officials, scholars, or nobles treat the document as serious before arguing content. Can force a record, petition, or accusation to receive formal attention.

entries.name: Weight of the Deep
entries.summary: Condense the sensation and pressure of impossible depth around one target or tightly bounded area, crushing movement, sound, courage, and breath beneath supernatural heaviness. Strong resistance, protective magic, or escape from the affected space can break the pressure.

entries.name: Weighted Coin
entries.summary: You place subtle magical weight on one immediate binary uncertainty, making one plausible outcome slightly more likely while increasing tension around the alternative. It never makes the impossible happen.

entries.name: Whisper Price
entries.summary: Trade information without revealing the source, making the buyer pay in favors, silence, access, or future obligation. Trades information for favors, silence, access, or future obligation without exposing the source.

entries.name: Whisper Thread
entries.summary: You carry a quiet voice or simple sound along a chosen path to a nearby listener while suppressing spill into the surrounding area.

entries.name: White-Heat Edge
entries.summary: Compress fire and heat into an extremely narrow cutting line along a hand, tool, weapon, or visible path. Use this to burn through a resistant point, sever material, cauterize precisely, or overwhelm a single defense without flooding the whole area with flame.

entries.name: Whiteout Field
entries.summary: You fill a broad area with freezing haze, blowing ice, and treacherous frost. It obscures sight, slows movement, and punishes exposed bodies without giving you perfect control over every target inside.

entries.name: Wild Form
entries.summary: You assume a partial or full beast aspect tied to a bonded or studied creature for one scene. Use this to gain movement, senses, natural weapons, survival traits, or animal instincts while keeping the transformation limited by the chosen beast nature.

entries.name: Wild Intercession
entries.summary: Read the instant before an animal attack fully commits and redirect it with movement, voice, or dominance. Can turn a beast assault into hesitation or warning behavior.

entries.name: Wind Burst
entries.summary: You release a sudden burst of pressurized air to push, stagger, deflect, or clear gas, dust, smoke, or loose debris. Use this to create space, break line of sight, or interrupt a fragile action.

entries.name: Windwall Sphere
entries.summary: You spin air around yourself or a small group into a defensive shell. It can deflect arrows, debris, smoke, and attacks from several directions, though heavy or anchored force can break through.

entries.name: Witness Clause
entries.summary: Bind a clearly spoken and willingly witnessed promise to reveal when its defined terms are fulfilled or broken. The magic records the agreement and its breach; it does not force obedience, invent unstated terms, or decide ambiguous law by itself.

entries.name: Witness Discipline
entries.summary: Question a witness in a structured way that separates what they personally saw or heard from assumptions, inferences, and hearsay. On success, their account becomes clearer and harder to blur; this does not force honesty or knowledge they do not possess.

entries.name: Witness Trick
entries.summary: You turn an entire exchange into sleight-of-hand theatre, making witnesses certain they saw events in the wrong order. Can rewrite the practical custody of a small object unless magic or direct restraint prevents it.

entries.name: Witnessed Promise
entries.summary: You magically witness a willing spoken promise so both parties feel when its exact terms are fulfilled or violated. The magic records obligation rather than forcing obedience.

entries.name: Wolf's Rush
entries.summary: You awaken the Wolf within the Luporian medallion and commit yourself to reaching a nearby person who is in danger or needs immediate protection. Use this to cross a short reachable distance with supernatural speed and timing, allowing you to reach them, pull them clear, place yourself between them and a threat, or otherwise intervene when ordinary movement would be too slow. It cannot cross impassable obstacles, function as teleportation, or automatically negate the danger once you arrive.

entries.name: Working Face
entries.summary: You build a cover identity around habit, posture, tools, dirt, scent, and expected social role, not just clothing. Lets you pass casual inspection by people who are not actively hunting you.

entries.name: Working Repair
entries.summary: You make a durable practical repair to common cloth, leather, wood, rope, packs, furniture, harness, or tools when suitable materials and time are available.

entries.name: Working Theory
entries.summary: Build a testable explanation from incomplete information without mistaking it for certainty. Creates a useful hypothesis that guides the next action.

entries.name: World Stitch
entries.summary: Stabilize a tear, overlap, or impossible space before it spreads. Holds a planar hazard in place long enough for escape, negotiation, or deeper ritual.

entries.name: Worldbearing Stance
entries.summary: You take on legendary load-bearing strength for one decisive act, holding a collapsing structure, stopping a colossal force, carrying impossible weight, or anchoring against disaster as long as your body can survive the strain.

entries.name: Worldbell
entries.summary: You release a vast controlled resonance through a major area, shaking structures, carrying a signal, breaking fragile material, and disrupting concentration across the scene. Its breadth makes collateral effects unavoidable.

entries.name: Worldcleaver Arc
entries.summary: You carry a weapon technique through a concentrated arc of mana capable of cutting a magical barrier, summoned structure, spell-shaped obstruction, or supernatural defense that an ordinary weapon could not meaningfully threaten. It still contests the strength and nature of the effect being cut.

entries.name: Worldhammer Wave
entries.summary: You release a massive directional wall of force that can sweep formations, break heavy cover, and move large debris across a battlefield lane. Its area is devastating but difficult to use without collateral effects.

entries.name: Worldline Navigation
entries.summary: You connect stars, roads, terrain, weather, memory, and instinct into a route that feels almost destined. Use this to guide a group through hostile land, impossible weather, misleading paths, or long-distance travel without losing the way.

entries.name: Worldlock
entries.summary: You create a legendary closure over a major threshold, chamber, conduit, or dangerous power. It can resist extraordinary intrusion for a decisive period, though no seal is absolutely unbreakable.

entries.name: Worldstone Aegis
entries.summary: You pull earth and stone into a layered omnidirectional fortress around a group or position. It can answer attacks from every direction and survive tremendous pressure, but it anchors the defended area and can be overwhelmed by legendary force.

entries.name: Worldward
entries.summary: You raise legendary guardian force around a group, structure, or critical objective against simultaneous catastrophic threats. It can buy survival where ordinary barriers fail, but sacrifice, exhaustion, and overwhelming force still matter.

entries.name: Woven Guard
entries.summary: You tighten and reinforce available cloth, layered fabric, rope, netting, or similar fiber into a temporary protective form. It may brace, catch, cushion, or obstruct an incoming threat according to the material present, but cannot provide protection beyond what magically reinforced fiber could plausibly withstand.

entries.name: Wrecking Charge
entries.summary: Commit to a brutal advance that ignores minor obstruction, weak formation edges, and fear of injury. Breaks through ordinary blocking bodies or fragile barriers.

entries.name: Wyrdmark
entries.summary: You notice when a person, place, object, or scene carries a story-pattern, curse-thread, prophecy mark, inherited doom, or strange repeated coincidence. Use this to sense that events are not random or recognize an old promise returning.

entries.name: Wyrm Sign
entries.summary: Recognize draconic symbolism, territorial habit, hoard logic, or ancient warning before others mistake it for decoration. Reveals the draconic meaning of a sign or place.

entries.name: Wyrm Warning Read
entries.summary: You read immediate draconic warning signs—posture, breath, territory marks, hoard behavior, manifestations of Type or Nature, and challenge rituals—to judge whether a dragon is curious, threatened, hunting, bluffing, or preparing to attack.

entries.name: Wyrm-Name Invocation
entries.summary: Speak an established draconic name, title, oath, or precedent with enough precision to invoke a tradition that the dragon or dragon-linked power actually recognizes. This can create strong leverage toward bargain, challenge, or formal response when that tradition has real standing, but grants no authority by itself and cannot force compliance.

entries.name: Zenith Judgment
entries.summary: You call concentrated midday-like solar force onto one declared target or corrupted focal point. It is a high-Power focused judgment, but must still overcome defenses and cannot arbitrarily decide moral guilt.
